payload.body: For WP05, from WP01's critic: a remote leg's seal pair is copied back only under its own leg directory (tmp/release/legs/<name>/, D62) and never into the local record directory, because the local GATES record is keyed on (commit, platform) and two Macs on one OS build and bash share a platform string; the leg's verdict is read from its own directory. FYI only -- no response needed.
